title: Flux 2 Pro
description: Image editing with FLUX.2 [pro] from Black Forest Labs. Ideal for high-quality image manipulation, style transfer, and sequential editing workflows

pricing.text: Your request will cost $0.03 for the first megapixel of output, plus $0.015 per extra megapixel of input and output, rounded up to the nearest megapixel. For example, a 1024x1024 image will cost $0.03, and a 1920x1080 image will cost $0.045 ($0.03 for first megapixel + $0.015 for the second megapixel). Similarly, a 512x512 output will cost $0.03 ($0.03 for 0.25 megapixels, rounded to 1 megapixel)

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.tooltip: The prompt to generate an image from.

inputs.name: image_size
inputs.tooltip: The size of the generated image. 'custom' uses the width and height below.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.tooltip: The seed to use for the generation. -1 leaves it to the model.

inputs.name: safety_tolerance
inputs.tooltip: The safety tolerance level for the generated image. 1 being the most strict and 5 being the most permissive.

inputs.name: enable_safety_checker
inputs.tooltip: Whether to enable the safety checker. Disabling it requires account authorization; unauthorized requests are always checked.

inputs.name: output_format
inputs.tooltip: The format of the generated image.

omitted.why: yes/no sync_mode returns the file inline and drops it from fal's request history - always left off
